name: app-shell-digest-inbox
title: Dual sidebar · digest inbox, reading-plan panel and an author directory
description: Dual sidebar · digest inbox, reading-plan panel and an author directory. Blocks/App Shell pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/blocks/AppShell and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in block built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system.
